decision: The unreachable src/enrich pipeline and its legacy synthetic end-to-end test are removed. Product behavior is exercised through canonical meeting, decision, approval, and delivery contracts in the real adapter-composed core cycle.
implemented_capabilities: product source boundary rejects any reintroduction of src/enrich
packaging regression proves that no enrichment artifact is distributed
Granola raw-event compatibility remains isolated from the canonical adapter and has no internal enrichment consumer
architectural_invariants: new meeting-derived behavior enters through canonical core contracts and typed adapters
historical extraction provenance remains immutable after retirement
no source module exists under src/enrich
retirement of the separately exported Granola compatibility API requires an explicit compatibility decision
